hero.title: Directly support the artist you’re listening to
hero.byline: Unstream finds the places where your favorite music artists — not big tech companies — keep up to 97% of every sale.

home.orSearch: Or search artists anytime at the top of the page 🔎

features.heading: Keep track of artists you want to support
features.detectionBody: The macOS menu bar app detects what’s playing in Spotify, Apple Music, or any media player on your Mac — no copy-paste needed.
features.saveBody: Build a list of artists you want to support. The app remembers them so you always know where to buy their music.
features.anonymousBody: No account required. No personal data collected. Only anonymized searches and clicks — nothing else.
features.freeBody: Unstream is free because the point is getting money to artists, not charging you. If you find it useful, consider

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.body: Can't find the artist you want to support? Have a feature idea? Reach out below.

tipPage.straightTo: Support for their music, paid straight to {{name}}'s own Stripe account.
tipPage.notTaking: {{name}} isn't taking tips on Unstream yet.
tipPage.seeWhereElse: See where else to support them →
